title: TSO500 ctDNA tissue-of-origin analysis code (SHAPE and multimodal tissue-of-origin classification)
description:
Analysis code for the study "Transcription factor-associated fragmentation reveals tissue-of-origin information in clinical targeted circulating tumor DNA sequencing." Includes extraction of Site-directed High-resolution Analysis of Positional Endpoints and Entropy (SHAPE) features at transcription factor binding sites, all-exon depth, exon 1 fragment-length entropy, broad copy-number, and somatic mutation modules, and the shrinkage non-negative least-squares late-fusion ensemble used for multimodal tissue-of-origin prediction from routine targeted circulating tumor DNA (TruSight Oncology 500) sequencing. See README for pipeline stages and MANIFEST.

Patent pending. Released under a proprietary license (all rights reserved) for academic verification and reproducibility; see LICENSE.
